subject: Helios Weekly Newsletter
html:
September 25, 2026

Early dismissal at 12:30pm Tue 9/29 – Fri 10/2 for ILP conferences

Students go home at 12:30pm each day of ILP week so teachers can meet with every family. Aftercare runs from 12:30pm as usual.

Mon 9/28 remains a full day, dismissal at 3:15pm

Monday is a regular school day; the early dismissals begin Tuesday.

Club start times shift earlier during ILP week (9/29–10/2)

Every club meets at 12:45pm instead of 3:30pm during ILP week. Please plan pick-ups to match.

Parent Ed Coffee with the Helios Board is Mon 10/5, 8:30–9:30am

Join the Board in the library for coffee and conversation about the year ahead.
